name: Random Equivalence Queries Complexity of Universal Class
proof: Every adversarial equivalence-query strategy remains correct under any fixed admissible random-counterexample distribution. Thus $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{req}}(\mathcal U_n;\mu)\le\mathrm L(\mathcal U_n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$, using the existing universal-class Littlestone value. This gives zero for $n=1$.
details: Upper bound only, for every fixed admissible counterexample distribution. The earlier exact equality used the unsupported pointwise VC lower bound; that equality and its asymptotic lower classification are withdrawn, not asserted false for every distribution.
